snippet.title: Dressing Room - Available for free on Itch.io
snippet.description:
From the creator of No.1 Itch.io game at the moment - "Customer Support", "Dressing Room" is the new continuation of the story that was described in my previous title. The game contains many tasks, dialogs, and SCARY events thruought the story.
The link to the game should be in the comments.

Developer: ColourPlay Games

Background Music:  aaronsdying
